Hi Lena — great questions. Answers below and updated timeline in the attached MAP.

1) PO vs signed MSA: We prefer to have an executed MSA before long-term production contracts, but we can accept a PO "subject to execution" for initial procurement if your legal prefers to finalize concurrently. For pilots, card works and we can convert to PO later.
2) Payment terms: We typically offer net-30 on enterprise contracts; net-45 can be accommodated for larger deals with approvals. Please confirm which your finance team prefers and we’ll reflect it in our invoice template.
3) Marketplace: Redwood is live on AWS Marketplace for select SKUs. If you want to purchase via marketplace, we can loop in our partner ops team — this can simplify procurement but may change billing terms (marketplace billing cadence).

Proposed adjusted timeline (parallelized where possible):
- Day 0: Share redlines + MAP (we did today)
- Days 1–7: Legal review (target 1 week)
- Days 1–10: Security review (we’ll provide SOC 2 report, SSO guide, and a short technical session)
- Days 11–15: Finance issues PO (1–5 business days after legal sign-off depending on your process)

If legal/security run in parallel we expect ~2–3 weeks to PO issuance. If you need faster turnaround, let us know and we can prioritize SSO/security docs/help schedule a call with our security lead.

Next steps: can you confirm preferred path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and share procurement contact + expected payment terms? I’ll update the MAP and route to our legal and finance teams.

Best,
Marissa
